senses.gloss:
1. गुप् गुप्, Par. Base of the present, etc., गोपाय (गोप, Gīt. 6, 12), Par.; and गोपय, Par. Ātm. (old Causals [] of गुह्; cf. रुह्).
 1. To guard, to protect, गोपायति, MBh. 6, 472; गोपयस्व, 5, 350; जुगोप, 6, 3897.
 2. To keep in memory, Gīt. 6, 12 (गोपतस्, ptcple. of the pres.).
 3. To conceal, Rājat. 5, 222; Pañc. ii. d. 106.
 4. † गोपय, To speak.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass., गोपित and गुप्त, Guarded, MBh. 1, 5090; Man. 7, 76. गुप्त + म् adv. Privately, Kathās. 5, 40.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass.
 1. गोप्तव्य and गोप्य, To be guarded, MBh. 12, 3449; 12, 1481.
 2. गोप्य, To be concealed, Pañc. i. d. 113.
 3. गोपनीय, To be prevented, MBh. 12, 5399.
 --Caus. गोपायय, To guard, MBh. 3, 10835.
 --Desider. जुगुप्स, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par. Rām. 2, 69, 20).
 1. To disdain, Man. 6, 58.
 2. To be offended, MBh. 1, 6375.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass., जुगुप्सित,
 1. Abominated, MBh. 3, 1288.
 2. Contemned, Man. 4, 209. n. 1. An abominable act, Bhāg. P. 1, 5, 15. 2. Abominableness, 1, 7, 42.
 --Comp.
 अ-जुगुप्सित, being reverenced, Man. 3, 209.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, अनुगुप्त, Guarded, MBh. 3, 8436. तम्, adv. Privately, MBh. 3, 251.
 --With अभि अभि, अभिगुप्त, Protected. MBh. 1, 7989.
 --With उप उप, उपगुप्त, Concealed, Bhāg. P. 4, 16, 10.
 --With परि परि, गोपाय To guard. Bhāg. P. 5, 2, 1.
 --Desider. To be on one's guard (with abl.), MBh. 12, 3136.
 --With प्र प्र, गोपय. To guard Pañc. i. d. 348.
 --With सम् सम्, संगुप्त,
 1. Protected, MBh. 13, 248. []
 2. Concealed, MBh. 13, 514.
 --Comp.
 सु-, adj. well guarded, MBh. 5, 900.
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, अभिसंगुप्त, Guarded, MBh. 3, 274.
2. गुप् गुप्, i. 4, Par. To be confused or disturbed.

गुप्ति गुप् + ति, f.
 1. Guarding, protecting, Rām. 2, 51, 3.
 2. Defences, Rām. 6, 12, 16.
 3. Concealing.
 --Comp.
